messages:
alex_support: FYI ACME reported duplicate token charges on INV-9872, ~3k tokens billed twice. They say their client retried after a 504. Can someone take a look?
ben_billing: Can you paste the request ids + any idempotency header they sent? Also which invoice lines are showing the duplicate?
alex_support: Customer says client_id=acme-web-1. From their logs: two POST /v1/generate with same payload within 8s. They included X-Client-Request-ID: c-4f2a but no Idempotency-Key header. Attaching our gateway logs snippet:```nginx
2026/03/10 14:12:03 [error] 12#12: upstream timed out (110: Connection timed out) while reading response header from upstream, client: 10.0.0.45, server: api.redwood, request: "POST /v1/generate HTTP/1.1", upstream: "http://10.1.5.7:8080/", host: "api.redwood"
2026/03/10 14:12:03 [info] gateway: retrying request id=ri-7892 due to upstream timeout
2026/03/10 14:12:11 [info] gateway: routed request id=ri-7893 to model-pool-2
```
and our metering service shows two meter events:```json
{"meter_event_id":"me-112","request_id":"ri-7892","client_request_id":"c-4f2a","tokens":3056}
{"meter_event_id":"me-113","request_id":"ri-7893","client_request_id":"c-4f2a","tokens":3056}
```
ben_billing: Ok that looks like the gateway retried and both attempts reached the metering pipeline. Do we dedupe on Idempotency-Key or client_request_id?
mira_infra: Current dedupe uses Idempotency-Key only. If that header is absent, we treat each request as unique. Gateway retries today reissues the request and does not synthesize an Idempotency-Key.
sam_sre: Confirmed. Our nginx sidecar will re-send the same POST but doesn't add Idempotency-Key. We do, however, preserve X-Client-Request-ID in headers, but metering dedupe ignores it.
ben_billing: So two independent meter events were written and invoiced. We need to reconcile invoice INV-9872. From billing-bot: can you pull the ledger entries?
billing-bot: Found ledger entries linked to INV-9872: line 3 -> me-112 (3056 tokens), line 4 -> me-113 (3056 tokens). Both marked billed.
ben_billing: Action: issue credit for duplicate line (me-113) and mark as investigated. + Send customer a note acknowledging duplicate and CC finance. Ticket TICKET-2045 created.
mira_infra: Longer term fix options: 1) update metering dedupe to also use X-Client-Request-ID when present, 2) have gateway attach/synthesize Idempotency-Key on initial request and ensure retries re-use same key, or 3) make retry logic not re-send body to metering until response confirmed. I'd prefer (2) for correctness.
sam_sre: Also need to tweak gateway retry logic: don't retry on 504 for streaming gen requests where client may retry. Add a header-preserve flag in retry path so Idempotency-Key isn't dropped. Filed CFG-112 for config change.
ben_billing: I'll file the credit now and coordinate refund. Alex — please get the customer's request ids and ask them to add Idempotency-Key on their side as best practice. We'll update docs.
alex_support: Will do. Messaging to ACME: "We're issuing a one-time credit for the duplicate tokens and pushing a fix to prevent this class of double-billing. Ticket TICKET-2045." :thumbsup:
mira_infra: I'll prototype gateway change to set Idempotency-Key = X-Client-Request-ID when missing and ensure retries reuse the header. If that proves risky, we fallback to metering dedupe change.
ben_billing: Thanks all. Closing loop once credit processed and CFG-112/TICKET-2045 are linked to the invoice.
